protocol_metadata.author_role: Lead Quantitative Researcher & Research Governance Auditor
protocol_metadata.purpose: Normalized, internally consistent, and frozen experiment protocol for Sprint 6.2 validation-only parameter backtesting.

research_exposure_disclosure.disclosure_text: The candidate hypotheses governing Sprint 6.2 (entry probability threshold filtering theta in [0.35, 0.50], ATR-based trailing stops, and entry pacing) were directly informed by post-hoc inspection of the 2025-2026 test-set backtest P&L in Sprint 6.1. The 2025-2026 test period is formally RESEARCH-EXPOSED for these hypotheses and CANNOT be treated as an untouched out-of-sample holdout. This protocol restricts all parameter selection and evaluation strictly to the 2023-2024 validation dataset.

candidate_grid.grid_construction_methodology: Orthogonal One-Factor-At-A-Time (OFAT) sensitivity around a balanced central anchor (theta=0.40, fixed_5d exit, unconstrained pacing) plus targeted cross-factor interaction pairs. Constructed strictly using research constraints and sample size considerations, not test-period performance.

reference_baseline.description: Baseline argmax classifier with 5-session calendar exit and unconstrained entry pacing (Sprint 6.0 baseline logic).

configurations.description: Lowest discrete filter above baseline argmax; assesses mild turnover reduction.
Sub-anchor threshold testing intermediate conviction filtering.
Central experimental anchor with baseline calendar exit.
Moderate threshold above anchor; evaluates trade-off between selectivity and volume.
High conviction threshold filtering for upper decile model confidence.
Very high conviction threshold approaching top 1% validation signals.
Extreme conviction boundary; tests upper bound of viable signal density.
Central anchor with tight trailing stop; tests rapid loss truncation.
Central anchor with standard trailing stop; balances drift protection and volatility tolerance.
Central anchor with wide trailing stop; permits broader swing excursions.
Central anchor with strict 2-entries-per-day cap; limits concurrent cluster risk.
Central anchor with 3-entries-per-day cap; permits moderate daily entry bursts.
Interaction of moderate threshold with 2.0x ATR trailing stop.
Interaction of high conviction threshold with 2.0x ATR trailing stop.
Triple interaction: high threshold, 2.0x ATR exit, and strict daily entry pacing.
Interaction of very high threshold with 2.0x ATR trailing stop.

mandatory_acceptance_criteria.definition: Annualized net Sharpe ratio (Rf=6.0% annual, 252 sessions/year) computed from daily mark-to-market equity returns net of full statutory delivery friction and 5 bps slippage.
Strategy net cumulative return must exceed the 49-constituent Equal-Weight Buy & Hold benchmark net return over 2023-2024.
Peak-to-trough mark-to-market equity drawdown must not exceed 15.00% at any point in the validation period.
Strategy must complete at least 100 closed trades over the 2-year validation period to prevent sample starvation.
Strategy must execute at least 40 completed trades in each individual calendar year (classified by entry_date).
Ratio of sum of net winning trades to absolute sum of net losing trades (Sum(net_pnl > 0) / |Sum(net_pnl < 0)|) must be >= 1.15.

mandatory_acceptance_criteria.metric: Total Friction as % of Gross Alpha
mandatory_acceptance_criteria.definition: Total statutory taxes, fees, and slippage must not exceed 100.00% of positive gross alpha (Gross Alpha must be > 0 and Friction <= Gross Alpha).
DSR p-value adjusted for K=16 candidate trials, return skewness, and return kurtosis under Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014) must be < 0.05.

automatic_rejection_triggers.trigger: Net Cumulative Return <= Net Equal-Weight Benchmark Return
Completed Trades in 2023 < 40 OR Completed Trades in 2024 < 40
Total Friction > 100.00% of Gross Alpha OR Gross Alpha <= 0.0
DSR p-value >= 0.05 OR DSR undefined / uncomputable
Portfolio Cash < 0.0 on any date OR Concurrent Positions > 10 on any date
Any mandatory metric is NaN, division-by-zero, or cannot be reliably computed

diagnostic_metrics_only: Gross Win Rate (%) vs Net Win Rate (%)
Holm-Bonferroni Adjusted p-values for Secondary Metric Comparisons

statistical_testing_procedure.return_series: Daily portfolio mark-to-market net return series: R_t = (Equity_t - Equity_{t-1}) / Equity_{t-1}
statistical_testing_procedure.frequency: Daily trading sessions (T = 490 trading sessions in 2023-2024 validation period)

deflated_sharpe_ratio_specification.reference: Bailey, D. H., & Lopez de Prado, M. (2014). The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting, and Non-Normality. Journal of Portfolio Management, 40(5), 94-107.
deflated_sharpe_ratio_specification.trial_selection_rationale: K=16 reflects the exact, frozen discrete candidate grid size. No unrecorded, continuous, or preliminary trials are permitted.
deflated_sharpe_ratio_specification.formula: DSR = Phi( ((SR_hat - SR_star) * sqrt(T - 1)) / sqrt(1 - gamma_3 * SR_hat + ((gamma_4 - 1)/4) * SR_hat^2) )
deflated_sharpe_ratio_specification.skewness_input: Sample skewness gamma_3 of daily validation return series
deflated_sharpe_ratio_specification.kurtosis_input: Sample kurtosis gamma_4 of daily validation return series

multiple_comparisons_correction.application: Applied across secondary metric comparisons for all K=16 configurations to control Family-Wise Error Rate (FWER) at alpha = 0.05.

serial_correlation_and_overlap_disclosur.disclosure: Positions are held for up to 5 trading sessions, producing overlapping holding periods that induce positive serial correlation in daily portfolio equity returns. Standard i.i.d. assumptions underestimate Sharpe standard errors. When calculating Sharpe ratios, a Newey-West / HAC adjustment with 5 lags must be reported in diagnostics alongside the classical Sharpe ratio.

statistical_testing_procedure.tooling_implementation_status: BLOCKED — DSR and Holm-Bonferroni calculations are not currently implemented in the codebase.

exit_rule_technical_feasibility.bar_resolution: Daily OHLCV bars only (no intraday tick, minute, or L2 order book data)
exit_rule_technical_feasibility.execution_timing_convention: Signal generated at session t Close (15:30 IST) -> Executed at session t+1 Open (09:15 IST) with 5 bps slippage

atr_calculation_specification.availability_timing: ATR for session t is finalized only after session t Close print.

trailing_stop_logic_under_daily_bars.trigger_evaluation_timing: End-of-Day Close Inspection (Zero Look-Ahead): At session t Close, inspect whether Close_t <= (Peak_Close_since_entry - multiplier * ATR_{14, t})
trailing_stop_logic_under_daily_bars.execution_timing: If stop triggered at session t Close, position exits at session t+1 Open with 5 bps slippage
trailing_stop_logic_under_daily_bars.gap_down_handling: If session t+1 Open gaps below the trigger level, execution occurs at Open_{t+1} * (1 - slippage), absorbing the full adverse gap. No artificial fill at the stop price.
trailing_stop_logic_under_daily_bars.intraday_stop_rejection: Intraday stop simulation (filling at the exact stop level when Low <= Stop) is STRICTLY REJECTED because daily bars cannot determine whether High occurred before Low, nor can they determine the fill price during gap events.

exit_rule_technical_feasibility.backtest_engine_implementation_status: BLOCKED — EventDrivenBacktestEngine does not currently contain ATR calculation, trailing stop tracking, stop trigger evaluation, or daily entry pacing limits. Modifying the engine is prohibited during Sprint 6.1.3 and must be completed in a separate engineering task.

portfolio_and_execution_invariants.model_feature_space: Exact 30 approved econometric features (APPROVED_FEATURES). Zero raw OHLCV or identifier leakage.

completed_trade_definition.entry: Order successfully executed at session t+1 Open with cash debited and shares credited.
completed_trade_definition.exit: Position closed at session exit Open (or synthetic final session Close) with cash credited.
completed_trade_definition.rejected_orders: Orders rejected due to position cap or volume halts do NOT count as completed trades.
completed_trade_definition.end_of_period_liquidations: Liquidations on the final validation session are counted in total trades but flagged as synthetic exits in diagnostics.

calendar_year_assignment.assignment_rule: Every trade is assigned to a calendar year based strictly on its ENTRY_DATE.

benchmark_specification.name: NIFTY 50 Equal-Weight Buy & Hold (Validation Period)
benchmark_specification.valuation_convention: Mark-to-market daily close on identical session calendar as strategy.

prohibited_actions: Do not execute any backtest on test_dataset.parquet (2025-01-01 to 2026-07-22).
Do not expand the candidate grid beyond the 16 frozen configurations.
Do not perform continuous parameter tuning, third-decimal sweeps, or random search.
Do not add, remove, or modify candidates after validation results are visible.
Do not retrain, recalibrate, or modify models/lightgbm.joblib.
Do not modify feature definitions, labels, or dataset parquet files.
Do not alter the statutory cost model, 5 bps slippage, or next-session execution timing.
Do not relax any mandatory acceptance criterion or ignore rejection triggers.
Do not fabricate or proxy DSR significance without genuine statistical computation.
Do not deploy live capital, dashboards, or frontends based on validation backtests.

freeze_status_and_blockers.overall_governance_decision: BLOCKED — PROTOCOL OR IMPLEMENTATION ISSUES REMAIN

unresolved_blockers.description: EventDrivenBacktestEngine does not implement ATR calculation, trailing stop tracking, or stop exit staging. Backtesting configurations CFG-08 through CFG-10 and CFG-13 through CFG-16 is technically impossible without modifying the engine.
unresolved_blockers.resolution_requirement: Implement EOD-evaluated, next-open-executed ATR trailing stop logic in EventDrivenBacktestEngine under a separately authorized engineering task.

unresolved_blockers.description: EventDrivenBacktestEngine hardcodes 'if sig == 1:' (argmax) and does not accept a dynamic entry threshold theta (prob_buy >= theta) or a daily entry pacing limit (max_daily_entries).
unresolved_blockers.resolution_requirement: Parameterize run_simulation() to accept prob_buy_threshold (float) and max_daily_entries (Optional[int]) under a separately authorized engineering task.

unresolved_blockers.description: Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR) and Holm-Bonferroni multiple comparison procedures are required by the acceptance criteria but do not exist in the codebase.
unresolved_blockers.resolution_requirement: Implement a mathematically verified deflated_sharpe_ratio() function in a dedicated statistics utility module.
